from ninja import Router
from ninja.security import HttpBearer
from ninja.errors import HttpError
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from organizations.models import OrganizationUser

org_membership_router = Router(auth=HttpBearer())

@org_membership_router.delete("/organizations/{org_id}/members/{user_id}")
def remove_organization_member(request, org_id: int, user_id: int):
    caller_id = request.auth.id
    # Check if caller is removing themselves or is an admin of the specified organization
    is_self = caller_id == user_id
    is_admin = OrganizationUser.objects.filter(organization_id=org_id, user_id=caller_id, is_admin=True).exists()

    if not is_self and not is_admin and not request.auth.is_staff:
        raise HttpError(403, "You do not have permission to remove members from this organization")

    membership = get_object_or_404(OrganizationUser, organization_id=org_id, user_id=user_id)
    membership.delete()
    return {"status": "removed", "user_id": user_id, "organization_id": org_id}
